title: Kernel finiteness from local generating epimorphisms
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and $U\subseteq X$ open. Let $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal H$ be a morphism of module sheaves on the open slice over $U$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $q$ be local generating data for $\mathcal F$: objects $V_i$ covering the terminal object of that slice and generating epimorphisms $p_i:\mathcal O_{V_i}^{\oplus I_i}\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal F|_{V_i}$, with no finiteness assumption on $I_i$. If $\ker(\varphi|_{V_i}\circ p_i)$ is of finite type [pqf-def-coherent] for every $i$ (composition in categorical order: first $p_i$, then $\varphi|_{V_i}$), then $\ker\varphi$ is of finite type on the slice over $U$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian), proof of (2), second paragraph: kernel is the image of the composite from local free relations; Lemma 01B7 (lemma-extension-finite-type), part (1), and Definition 01B5 (definition-finite-type). Verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01BY.

proof.text: For each i put L_i = kernel(p_i then phi restricted to V_i). The composite L_i -> free(I_i) -> F restricted to V_i is killed by phi, hence factors through kernel(phi restricted to V_i). Sectionwise kernels identify this latter module with the restriction of kernel phi. These identifications are valid on iterated slices because they only forget an intermediate inclusion of opens.

The factor L_i -> kernel(phi restricted to V_i) is epi. Given a section of the latter kernel, local lifting through p_i supplies preimages of its underlying F section. The image of each preimage under the composite is zero, so the preimage is a section of L_i. Thus every section of the kernel lifts locally through the factor, which is exactly the epimorphism criterion. This is the local lifting argument of the cited node applied to the open ringed space underlying V_i.

Push finite local generating families of L_i through this epimorphism. They generate kernel(phi restricted to V_i), proving it finite type by the image lemma. Refine the covering family V_i by the finite generating covers just obtained. Composition of coverings gives a cover of U. The forgetful identification of successive slices transports each generating family to the restriction of kernel phi on that cover, with the same finite index set and epimorphism. These form LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType for kernel phi, hence kernel phi is finite type. No finiteness of I_i is used; an empty cover only occurs over the empty open and gives the vacuous finite type condition.
